entries.clue: River to the Bay of Biscay
The Niger River flows through it
"As ___ the land at eve we went" (Tennyson)
The Truckee connects it to Pyramid Lake
It was created during Innocent III's reign
Native Americans known for their beadwork
Fabric named for a Mideast capital
A hard time, so to speak
A horn is named for him
It can be controlled in cars
City near Vandenberg Air Force Base
